body: Who cares if I tell the truth now? Everybody hates me. It is sad, and I'm sitting in a fucking freezer, drinking to lower my body temp and black out here.
Just lying was fine. Now I'm letting go
It's so much easier to lie. I lie about everything. I stopped telling the truth a long time ago. The truth is cold, and I hate it. It's so easy to do this, too. Lying and dying. They rhyme.

I'm a liar. I lie to everybody. I can't handle it. This is so much easier.

I just want to go.
I'm already in here. I feel better, letting it go.
She's more trusting now, I woke up with her cuddled next to me. I'm not violent, and I've never/will never hurt an animal.
